paper.title: Horse behavior and facial movements in relation to food rewards
paper.authors: Carmo LG, Werner LC, Michelotto PV Jr, Daros RR

claims.source_location: Abstract p.1; Results 3.2 Behavior in the chute p.9; methods 2.6 pp.7-8
claims.claim_paraphrase: Lowered-neck odds in the positively reinforced phase relative to baseline: OR 0.05, printed 95% CI 0.00-0.56, P=0.05.

columns.NECK_ABAIXO: Binary outcome: lowered neck (1) versus not observed (0); NA is missing.
columns.GRUPO: Fixed phase effect: Baseline reference, Experimental contrast; Controle excluded.
columns.NOME: Horse identifier for random intercept and repeated measurements.
columns.EXP_ORDEM: Treatment sequence exists in raw data; not in final author formula.

claims.missing_policy: Model frame complete cases on NECK_ABAIXO, GRUPO, NOME; assumes normal R na.omit and must be recorded at execution.
claims.method: lme4::glmer, binomial family, default logit link
claims.ci: Exponentiate profile likelihood confint(model); author helper rounds to 2 decimals.
claims.p: summary(glmer) Wald z test for GRUPOExperimental; retain full precision and check printed rounding.
claims.design: All three baseline days and final PR day (day 6 or 9 by crossover assignment), random intercept by horse. Final formula omits treatment order/age; do not describe it as period-adjusted crossover inference.
claims.rounding_note: Printed CI lower bound 0.00 is rounded, not evidence of a mathematically zero lower bound.

filters: All three days of each phase; no final-day filter
claims.method: Sum observed binary NECK_SUPERELEVADO values separately by GRUPO; record missing counts separately.
claims.interpretation: Match of the recorded elevated-neck totals only. Not complete-case proof of absence on missing sessions and not verification of lowered-neck mixed-model inference.
